briefing.headline: US-China AI compute race intensifies as OpenAI and xAI push frontier boundaries

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The global AI race has entered a high-stakes phase with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with enhanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 and xAI's Grok-3 show gains in long-horizon planning. DeepSeek R2 matches Western performance at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic AI risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters. TSMC's 2nm process yields exceed expectations for next-gen AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination breakthroughs trigger an uncontrolled intelligence explosion before 2028?
